title: Trie Prefix Index
summary: Represent strings character by character so words with the same prefix share a path and a prefix query can jump directly to the subtree of matching keys.
recognition_signals: queries are about prefixes rather than only exact equality
autocomplete, prefix enumeration, or longest-prefix matching is frequent
core_rules: Following all characters proves only that a prefix path exists; exact-key membership also requires a terminal marker.
For autocomplete, the node reached by the prefix is the frontier for enumerating matching complete keys.
structural_steps: insert each key by following or creating one character edge at a time
mark the final node as terminal
for a query walk the requested prefix
if the path exists continue from that node according to the query type

common_confusions.distinction: Hash lookup is usually simpler for exact whole-key membership. A trie is useful when the internal prefix structure of the keys is itself part of the query.
